label_overstatement_grounds: 'recalibration' implies a settable value: NO single cap grades on more than 1 of 3 seeds. 'mixed regime' implies a regime: the mixed band is at most ONE grid step (0.25 cap units) wide in every seed that showed it. A 'some grid point lands in (0.1,0.9)' predicate on a 5-point grid detects a CROSSING, not gradedness, and its pass probability rises with grid density regardless of the arbitration's smoothness. It therefore cannot discriminate H1 (graded arbitration) from H2 (structurally bang-bang with a narrow crossing) -- the exact discrimination the GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio exists to make. mechanism_findings: The clamp is value = max(-cap, min(cap, value)) applied to every affinity input before per-mode weighting (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py:455-465). But external_task_drive is ALREADY bounded to [0,1] by construction (ree_core/agent.py:6958, max(0.0, min(1.0, commit + prox))). So the clamp is a NO-OP on that signal at every cap >= 1.0; only cap = 0.75 touches it. At caps 1.0/1.25/1.5/1.75 the sweep manipulates only the COMPETING unbounded affinity inputs (canonically dacc_pe, magnitude ~16 per the pre-authoring probe), which is why ext_margin_mean falls monotonically with cap in every seed. The 'graded regime' is a logit crossing slid past by loosening the competitor's clamp, not a gradedness property.

A SECOND, cap-INDEPENDENT discreteness source exists and no cap can grade it: ree_core/agent.py:6944, _et_commit = _et_commit_w * (1.0 if self.beta_gate.is_elevated else 0.0) -- a boolean latch. At the default commit_weight = 1.0 the engagement scalar saturates at exactly 1.0 whenever the commitment latch is on, whatever the proximity term. The mode-governance-engagement substrate entry already recorded this from the 2026-08-13 synthetic probe ('H1 and H2 are not mutually exclusive as originally framed'); this run's data is consistent with it and does nothing to separate them.

The MECH-266 manipulation arm ARM_ASYM_STICKY_TASK read fraction_in_external_task = 1.0 with n_switches = 0 in ALL 15 cells (3 seeds x 5 caps). That is the sticky exit rail working as designed and yields no dose-response gradient of any kind.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: AIC-dACC coupled salience network switching between large-scale networks (Menon & Uddin 2010; Craig 2009) for SD-032a; BG direct/indirect pathway asymmetry and tonic-DA hysteresis (Cools 2008; Collins & Frank 2014 OPAL D1/D2 opponency) for MECH-266.
dependencies: graded lateral inhibition among competing striatal/cortical populations
a graded commitment signal (vigour / eligibility) rather than a boolean latch
biological_reference.divergence: LOAD-BEARING. affinity_input_cap bounds an unbounded competing input with a hard box clamp, max(-cap, min(cap, value)). Biology bounds competing drives with saturating gain and divisive normalization (Carandini & Heeger canonical normalization; Reynolds & Heeger 2009 normalization-of-attention; Kohnomi 2016 DA-graded lateral inhibition; Pommer 2021 SPN lateral inhibition) -- all of which are already in the REE literature corpus, but tagged to MECH-439 / ARC-108 / ARC-110, not to SD-032a or MECH-266. A box clamp has a discontinuous derivative: linear below, flat above, with a vanishingly narrow transition between 'competitor dominates' and 'drive dominates'. That is precisely the observed <= 1-grid-step crossing. A saturating/normalizing transform compresses smoothly and yields a WIDE graded crossing -- the regime MECH-266's hysteresis needs in order to express at all. The same divergence appears one level down: biological commitment is graded, whereas _et_commit is boolean. So 'the cap is mis-calibrated' (H1) and 'the register is structurally bang-bang' (H2) may both be answering the wrong question: the BOUNDING OPERATOR is the wrong shape.
biological_reference.lit_gap: No targeted_review covering bounding / normalizing of competing affinity signals is tagged to SD-032a or MECH-266. The relevant entries exist under targeted_review_connectome_mech_439 (canonical_normalization_carandini2012, normalization_attention_reynolds2009) and targeted_review_striatal_gain_control_bounding (da_graded_lateral_inhibition_kohnomi2016, spn_lateral_inhibition_pommer2021).

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Three coupled items. A box clamp's discontinuous derivative is what produces the observed <= 1-grid-step crossing; a saturating operator widens it, which is the precondition MECH-266's hysteresis needs to express. Keep the existing clamp reachable behind a mode selector so the V3-EXQ-934 baseline stays reproducible. learning_extracted: An existential over a swept parameter, evaluated PER SEED, cannot establish a shippable operating point. Always report the per-cap cross-seed count beside the per-seed existential -- here they disagree completely (2/3 seeds 'graded', but 1/3 seeds at the best single cap).

A 'some grid point falls in the mixed band' predicate on a coarse grid detects a CROSSING, not GRADEDNESS, and its pass probability rises with grid density regardless of the arbitration's smoothness. It therefore cannot separate a graded-arbitration hypothesis from a steep-switching one. A gate meant to make that discrimination needs a width/steepness readout (band width in parameter units, or d(occupancy)/d(cap) at the crossing), not an existential.

An aggregate that implies contiguity it does not have is a misleading statistic: winning_cap_band_symmetric = [min, max] over disjoint singletons reads as a band and is not one. Report the per-seed mixed_band_caps sets and their intersection.

Bounding an unbounded competing input with a hard box clamp is a formal-engineering import diverging load-bearingly from biology's saturating gain / divisive normalization -- and the divergence IS the observed knife-edge. Load-bearing by default, per the SD-003 precedent.

H1 and H2 are not mutually exclusive, because a second cap-INDEPENDENT discreteness source exists (_et_commit is a boolean latch on beta_gate.is_elevated). The frozen-ledger question was posed as an exclusive three-way choice and the substrate has outgrown that framing.

RECORDING GAP: enabled_default_off_flags was null, yet the entire finding is conditional on two default-off knobs. A run whose finding is configuration-conditional should record the enabled default-off flags machine-readably -- that field is precisely what a later reader needs to detect production-inertness without reading the substrate.
